c=new Ti(t,r,e,Zh,Ei);return c.wrapS=ys,c.wrapT=qn,c.minFilter=Wt,c.magFilter=Wt,c.generateMipmaps=!1,c.needsUpdate=!0,c}const pE=`
#include <fog_pars_vertex>
uniform float uTime;
uniform float uSeaR;      // 海面球半径 = R + SEA
uniform float uWaveAmp;   // 径向起伏幅度
varying vec3 vDir;        // 世界方向（模型矩阵后归一化，组旋转无关）
void main() {
  vec3 dir = normalize((modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz);
  float ph = dot(dir, vec3(2.3, 1.9, 2.7));                 // 低频波相位（沿用旧版取向）
  float rr = uSeaR + uWaveAmp * sin(uTime * ${Bs(Fn.waveSpeed)} + ph);
  vec4 mvPosition = viewMatrix * vec4(dir * rr, 1.0);       // fog_vertex 需要 mvPosition
  gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mvPosition;
  vDir = dir;
  #include <fog_vertex>
}
`,mE=`
#include <fog_pars_fragment>
uniform sampler2D uDepthTex;
uniform float uTime;
uniform vec3 uColShallow;   // A_L
uniform vec3 uColMid;       // A
uniform vec3 uColDeep;      // A_D
uniform vec3 uColFoam;      // CLOUD（世界里近白一律 CLOUD，契约 §一.3）
uniform float uOpacity;
varying vec3 vDir;

const float ENC = ${Bs(Fn.encRange)};

// 手写 hash / 值噪声（禁外部噪声库）
float hash13(vec3 p) {
  p = fract(p * 0.1031);
  p += dot(p, p.zyx + 31.32);
  return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.z);
}
float vnoise3(vec3 p) {
  vec3 i = floor(p);
  vec3 f = p - i;
  f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
  float n000 = hash13(i);
  float n100 = hash13(i + vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0));
  float n010 = hash13(i + vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));
  float n110 = hash13(i + vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.0));
  float n001 = hash13(i + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
  float n101 = hash13(i + vec3(1.0, 0.0, 1.0));
  float n011 = hash13(i + vec3(0.0, 1.0, 1.0));
  float n111 = hash13(i + vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
  return mix(
    mix(mix(n000, n100, f.x), mix(n010, n110, f.x), f.y),
    mix(mix(n001, n101, f.x), mix(n011, n111, f.x), f.y),
    f.z);
}

void main() {
  vec3 dir = normalize(vDir);
  // 等距柱状查水深：u = lon/2π + 0.5（atan2(x,z)，与 planet 经度同约定），v = acos(y)/π
  vec2 uv = vec2(atan(dir.x, dir.z) * 0.15915494 + 0.5,
                 acos(clamp(dir.y, -1.0, 1.0)) * 0.31830989);
  vec2 enc = texture2D(uDepthTex, uv).rg;
  float depth = (enc.x + enc.y / 255.0) * ENC;

  // --- 深度三阶硬断（cel：step 量化，禁平滑渐变）---
  vec3 col = mix(uColMid, uColShallow, step(depth, ${Bs(Fn.bandShallow)}));
  col = mix(col, uColDeep, step(${Bs(Fn.bandDeep)}, depth));
  col *= mix(1.0, ${Bs(Fn.abyssDim)}, step(${Bs(Fn.bandAbyss)}, depth)); // 更深再压一档

  // --- 微光斑：低频噪声成簇 + 时间量化阈值闪烁（近岸湿沙微反光更密）---
  float clump = vnoise3(dir * 3.6 + vec3(uTime * 0.05));
  float gate = mix(0.78, 0.68, step(depth, 0.35));
  float sparkle = step(gate, clump)
    * step(0.5, hash13(floor(dir * 34.0) + floor(uTime * 2.0)));
  col = mix(col, uColShallow, sparkle);

  // --- 岸沫带：3 频正弦脉动 + 高频噪声撕边 + 外缘破碎 ---
  float ph1 = dot(dir, vec3(1.7, 2.4, 2.1)) * 2.0;
  float ph2 = dot(dir, vec3(2.6, 1.3, 2.9)) * 2.0;
  float ph3 = dot(dir, vec3(2.2, 1.8, 2.5)) * 2.0;
  float pulse = 0.86
    + 0.09 * sin(uTime * 0.42 + ph1)
    + 0.05 * sin(uTime * 0.23 - ph2)
    + 0.05 * sin(uTime * 0.71 + ph3);
  float tear = vnoise3(dir * 46.0 + vec3(7.7, 3.1, 5.3)); // 高频撕边（静态形状）
  float fw = ${Bs(Fn.foamWidth)} * pulse * (0.62 + 0.48 * tear);
  float foam = step(depth, fw);
  float fleck = step(depth, fw * ${Bs(Fn.foamFleck)})
    * step(0.62, hash13(floor(dir * 40.0) + 3.1));        // 外缘破碎斑
  float foamAll = max(foam, fleck);
  col = mix(col, uColFoam, foamAll);

  // --- 透明度：整体 0.8；沫带更实；陆上水膜基本让位（通常已被地形遮挡）---
  float alpha = mix(uOpacity, 0.95, foamAll);
  alpha *= mix(0.15, 1.0, step(0.0005, depth));

  gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha);
  #include <fog_fragment>
}
`;function gE(r){const e=r!=="mobile",[t,n]=Fn.segs[e?"desktop":"mobile"],[i,s]=Fn.bake[e?"desktop":"mobile"],o=fE(i,s),a=new pi({uniforms:{...Sf.clone(Ce.fog),uTime:{value:0},uSeaR:{value:m_+Fn.SEA},uWaveAmp:{value:Fn.waveAmp},uDepthTex:{value:o},uColShallow:{value:new me(C.A_L)},uColMid:{value:new me(C.A)},uColDeep:{value:new me(C.A_D)},uColFoam:{value:new me(C.CLOUD)},uOpacity:{value:Fn.opacity}},vertexShader:pE,fragmentShader:mE,transparent:!0,depthWrite:!1,fog:!0}),c=new re(new
